crop-top.context: A short-sleeved top that stops well above the waist, with a bare gap above a waistband. Used in fashion shops, outfit planners and summer clothing categories.

turtleneck.context: A long-sleeved sweater with a tall collar folded up around the neck. Used for knitwear categories, winter clothing, outfit apps and cold weather style guides.

henley-shirt.context: A long-sleeved shirt with a round collarless neck and a short row of buttons. Used in menswear shops, casual clothing categories and outfit planners.

hawaiian-shirt.context: A short-sleeved shirt with an open camp collar and flowers printed across the front. Used for holiday and beach themes, summer shop categories and tropical party invitations.

flannel-shirt.context: A long-sleeved collared shirt covered in a plaid grid. Used for casual and outdoor clothing, autumn style guides, lumberjack or cabin themes and workwear shops.

long-sleeve-shirt.context: A plain crew-neck shirt with full-length sleeves, drawn with the arms held out. Used for basics and tops categories, size guides, uniform orders and layering outfits.

v-neck-shirt.context: A short-sleeved T-shirt with a deep V-shaped neckline. Used in clothing shops, neckline filters, basics collections and outfit planners.

raglan-shirt.context: A T-shirt with contrast sleeves joined by diagonal seams from the underarm to the collar. Used for sports and casual tees, baseball style shirts and custom print shops.

rugby-shirt.context: A long-sleeved shirt with wide horizontal stripes, a pointed collar and a short button placket. Used for rugby clubs and team kit, preppy fashion and sportswear shops.

breton-shirt.context: A long-sleeved boat-neck top with thin, evenly spaced horizontal stripes. Used for nautical and French style fashion, striped tops and seaside themes.

halter-top.context: A sleeveless top held up by straps that meet behind the neck, leaving the shoulders bare. Used in summer fashion, swimwear and womenswear shops and outfit apps.

off-shoulder-top.context: A top with a straight neckline sitting below the shoulders and short puffed sleeves. Used in womenswear shops, summer fashion, neckline filters and outfit planners.

one-shoulder-top.context: A top with a single shoulder strap and a diagonal neckline down to the other underarm. Used for evening and party wear, neckline filters and womenswear shops.

peplum-top.context: A fitted sleeveless top with a short flared ruffle below the waist seam. Used in womenswear shops, office and party outfits and sewing pattern sites.

corset.context: An hourglass bodice with a curved top edge and criss-cross lacing down the centre. Used for lingerie, historical costume, bridal and gothic fashion.

bodysuit.context: A one-piece long-sleeved top that ends in a high-cut brief at the hips. Used in womenswear, dancewear and gymnastics shops and fitted tops categories.

zip-hoodie.context: A hooded jacket with a full-length zipper down the front and two pockets. Used in casual wear and sportswear shops, merch stores and team gear.

quarter-zip-pullover.context: A long-sleeved pullover with a stand collar and a short zipper from the collar to mid chest. Used in sportswear, golf and outdoor clothing and layering guides.

sweater-vest.context: A sleeveless knit vest with a V-neck and a diamond argyle pattern. Used for preppy and school uniform styles, knitwear shops and knitting patterns.

tie-dye-shirt.context: A T-shirt with a swirl pattern spiralling out from the centre of the chest. Used for tie-dye kits, craft projects, festival and hippie themes and custom print shops.

referee-shirt.context: A short-sleeved collared shirt with bold vertical stripes, like a match official's jersey. Used for sports officiating, rules and fouls in sports apps and fancy dress.

sailor-suit.context: A top with a deep sailor collar and a neckerchief knotted at the point of the V. Used for nautical and navy themes, school uniforms, costumes and children's wear.

clerical-collar-shirt.context: A shirt with a dark band collar and a small white tab at the throat, as worn by clergy. Used for churches, religious services, ministry websites and costumes.

tailcoat.context: A formal coat cut short at the waist in front, with two long tails hanging behind. Used for white tie events, orchestras and conductors, ballroom dancing and weddings.

double-breasted-jacket.context: A suit jacket with wide lapels and two vertical rows of buttons. Used for tailoring and suit shops, business and formal wear, and menswear style guides.

puffer-jacket.context: A quilted jacket made of stacked puffy baffles with a high zipped collar. Used for winter clothing, outdoor gear shops, weather apps and cold weather packing lists.

parka.context: A long winter coat with a fur-trimmed hood and flap pockets. Used for winter and arctic clothing, outerwear shops, weather apps and cold climate travel guides.

denim-jacket.context: A button-front jacket with a pointed collar, two flap chest pockets and a waistband. Used in casual wear shops, denim collections and outfit planners.

cape.context: A short cloak hanging from the shoulders in a wide bell, tied with a bow at the neck. Used for costumes, superhero and fancy dress themes, outerwear and theatre.

cloak.context: A long hooded cloak falling to the floor, with a round clasp at the throat. Used for fantasy games, medieval and wizard themes, costumes and mystery or stealth features.

poncho.context: A poncho with a neck opening, a woven stripe and fringe along the lower edges. Used for Latin American and western themes, rainwear, festivals and knitting or crochet patterns.

scrubs.context: A short-sleeved V-neck medical top with a pen in the chest pocket. Used for hospitals, healthcare staff rotas, nursing and medical uniform shops.

high-visibility-vest.context: A sleeveless safety vest with reflective stripes across the body and over the shoulders. Used for construction sites, road works, safety rules, workwear and PPE checklists.

hazmat-suit.context: A full-body protective suit with an attached hood, a clear face visor and sealed gloves and boots. Used for chemical, biological and radiation hazards, labs and PPE guidance.

graduation-gown.context: An academic gown with wide bell sleeves and a front opening. Used for graduation ceremonies, commencement, universities, schools and gown rental or ordering.

wetsuit.context: A full-body neoprene suit with long arms and legs, a chest panel seam and a zip pull. Used for surfing, diving, snorkelling, triathlon and water sports rental.

jumpsuit.context: A one-piece garment with long sleeves and long legs, a collar and a belted waist. Used in fashion shops, workwear, flight suits and outfit planners.

romper.context: A one-piece short-sleeved top joined to short shorts, with a tie belt at the waist. Used for summer fashion, holiday outfits and womenswear or kidswear shops.

baby-onesie.context: A small short-sleeved baby bodysuit with an envelope neckline and snaps at the crotch. Used for baby shops, nursery lists, baby showers and parenting apps.

nightgown.context: A long loose sleeveless nightdress reaching the ankles, with a gathered yoke at the neckline. Used for sleepwear shops, bedtime and sleep tracking apps and hotel amenities.

long-johns.context: A one-piece thermal undergarment with long sleeves, long legs and buttons down the chest. Used for winter base layers, cold weather packing lists and vintage or cowboy themes.

waders.context: Chest-high waterproof trousers with attached boots and shoulder straps. Used for fishing and angling apps, outdoor shops, farming and wetland or river work.

cargo-pants.context: Trousers with a large flap pocket on the side of each thigh. Used for outdoor and utility clothing, workwear shops, hiking gear and streetwear.

sweatpants.context: Loose trousers with a drawstring waistband and cuffs gathered at the ankles. Used for loungewear, sportswear and gym clothing, comfort and working from home themes.

bell-bottoms.context: Trousers fitted at the thigh that flare out wide from the knee to the hem. Used for retro and 70s themes, disco parties and flared jeans categories.

ripped-jeans.context: Jeans with jagged tears across both knees. Used for denim shops, casual and grunge fashion, streetwear categories and style guides.

harem-pants.context: Very baggy trousers with a low drop crotch and legs gathered tightly at the ankles. Used for yoga and boho fashion, dance, festival wear and loungewear.

jodhpurs.context: Riding breeches that balloon out at the thighs and fit tightly from the knee down. Used for horse riding and equestrian shops, stables, polo and riding lessons.

lederhosen.context: Leather shorts with an H-shaped pair of braces joined by a chest strap. Used for Bavarian and Alpine themes, beer festivals, traditional dress and costumes.

kilt.context: A knee-length tartan kilt with a waistband and a sporran pouch hanging at the front. Used for Scottish and Highland themes, weddings, bagpipe bands and traditional dress.

chaps.context: A pair of leather leg coverings on a belt, open at the seat, with fringed outer edges. Used for cowboy and western themes, rodeos, horse riding and motorcycle gear.

sarong.context: A length of cloth wrapped around the hips and knotted at one side, falling to the ankle. Used for beach and resort wear, Southeast Asian and Pacific dress and swimwear cover-ups.

hakama.context: Wide pleated trousers that look like a long skirt, tied around the waist. Used for Japanese martial arts such as kendo, aikido and kyudo, and traditional Japanese dress.

suspenders.context: Two braces crossing in an X at the back and clipped to the waistband of a pair of trousers. Used for menswear accessories, formal wear, vintage styles and costume.

garter.context: A lace-edged elastic leg band with a ruffled edge and a small bow. Used for weddings and bridal accessories, lingerie shops and hen or bachelorette parties.

pencil-skirt.context: A straight narrow skirt reaching the knee, with a short slit at the hem. Used for office and workwear fashion, business outfits and womenswear shops.

tutu.context: A ballet bodice above a skirt of stiff layered tulle sticking straight out at the waist. Used for ballet schools, dance classes and recitals, and costume and party shops.

hoop-skirt.context: A bell-shaped skirt with horizontal hoop rings showing through it. Used for historical costume, Victorian and period drama themes, theatre and bridal petticoats.

grass-skirt.context: A waistband with long strands of grass hanging down from it. Used for luau and Hawaiian parties, tropical themes, hula dance and costume shops.

ball-gown.context: A gown with a fitted strapless bodice and a huge full skirt spreading to the floor. Used for formal events, proms and galas, princess themes and eveningwear shops.

evening-gown.context: A slim floor-length gown with thin straps and a high slit up one leg. Used for formal and red carpet events, eveningwear shops, awards nights and parties.

mermaid-gown.context: A floor-length gown fitted closely to the knee, then flaring out wide like a fish tail. Used for bridal and formal wear shops, proms and red carpet looks.

wedding-gown.context: A long gown with a sweetheart bodice, a full skirt and a train trailing behind. Used for weddings, bridal shops, wedding planners and marriage invitations.

wrap-dress.context: A dress with a crossover V neckline and a tie at the side of the waist. Used for day dresses, office and holiday outfits and womenswear shops.

flapper-dress.context: A straight drop-waist sleeveless dress with rows of hanging fringe. Used for 1920s and Gatsby parties, jazz age themes, vintage fashion and costumes.

flamenco-dress.context: A fitted dress that bursts into tiers of ruffles from the knee down to the floor. Used for flamenco and Spanish dance, Seville fairs, costumes and dance schools.

qipao.context: A fitted dress with a mandarin collar, a curved closure across the chest and a side slit. Used for Chinese culture and festivals, Lunar New Year, traditional dress and formal wear.

ao-dai.context: A long fitted tunic with a stand collar and side slits from the waist, worn over loose trousers. Used for Vietnamese culture, Tet celebrations, schools and traditional dress.

hanbok.context: A very short jacket tied with a long ribbon over a full high-waisted bell skirt. Used for Korean culture and holidays such as Chuseok and Seollal, weddings and traditional dress.

dirndl.context: A laced bodice over a puff-sleeved blouse, with a full skirt and a front apron. Used for Bavarian and Alpine themes, beer festivals, folk costume and traditional dress.

kaftan.context: A long loose robe with very wide sleeves and an embroidered band around a V neckline. Used for resort and beachwear, loungewear, boho fashion and Middle Eastern or North African dress.

abaya.context: A long loose robe reaching the ankles with long sleeves, an open front and a plain neck. Used for modest fashion, Gulf and Middle Eastern dress and Islamic clothing shops.

thobe.context: An ankle-length long-sleeved robe with a small stand collar and a short button placket. Used for Gulf and Middle Eastern menswear, Eid and Friday prayer outfits and traditional dress.
